title: Clerk API Error Response
description: Standard error body returned by every non-2xx API response. See docs/api/errors.md and docs/api/error-catalog.md.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code, namespaced by domain prefix (AUTH_, ORG_, ACCESS_, MODULE_, SOURCE_, JOB_, AI_, ARTIFACT_, WORKFLOW_, BILLING_, SECURITY_, VALIDATION_, IDEMPOTENCY_, RATE_, SYSTEM_ ...).

message.description: Human-readable, localizable message. Never contains secrets, stack traces or other tenants' data.

retryable.description: True if the same request may succeed when retried later (honour Retry-After).

field.description: JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) to the offending request field.

meta.description: Code-specific structured data, e.g. { required_entitlement: 'export.docx' } or { current_etag: '"v7"' }.

error.message: Your current plan does not include this module.
